pages.title: Someone Calls It Home
pages.text: Grow a settlement beyond a solitary building.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Use the normal resident registration and inspect that settlement’s list. Residents from different settlements do not add together; a second settlement is not required.

pages.title: Useful to know
pages.text: Enroll actual residents in your own town; foreign residents cannot be claimed and arrival needs a real path.
